findings.title: Non-integer path IDs return 404 instead of 400
findings.detail: Task requires 400 for 'an id in the path that is not an integer', but do_GET, do_PUT, and do_DELETE return 404 (or crash) when path ID is not an integer.

findings.title: POST /books and PUT /books do not validate string types for book fields
findings.detail: Task requires 400 for 'a field of the wrong type', but code accepts non-string types (e.g., int) for title, author, isbn without erroring.

findings.title: PUT /books/{id} and DELETE /books/{id} do not wrap int() in try/except
findings.detail: Without try/except, non-integer path ID triggers unhandled ValueError instead of returning 400.

findings.title: GET /books query parameter q filter checks b['q'] instead of searching all fields
findings.detail: Task requires q to search title/author/isbn/synopsis case-insensitively. Code uses b['q'].lower() which is not a book field.
